mapper.insert: INSERT INTO item ( item_name, item_brand, item_price, item_stock, item_category, item_type, reg_time ) VALUES ( #{itemName}, #{itemBrand}, #{itemPrice}, #{itemStock}, #{dbCategory}, #{dbType}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT i.item_id AS itemId, i.item_name AS itemName, i.item_brand AS itemBrand, i.item_price AS itemPrice, i.item_stock AS itemStock, i.item_category AS dbCategory, i.item_type AS dbType, i.reg_time AS regTime, img.item_url AS itemUrl FROM item i LEFT JOIN item_img img ON i.item_id = img.item_id AND img.is_main = 'Y' ORDER BY i.item_id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE item SET item_name = #{itemName}, item_brand = #{itemBrand}, item_price = #{itemPrice}, item_category = #{dbCategory}, item_type = #{dbType}, item_stock = #{itemStock}, update_time = NOW() WHERE item_id = #{itemId}
